main_idea: On-policy distillation improves GDPval performance across Nemotron and Qwen models.
ideas: Nemotron gains +20.9% net win-loss margin after distillation.
Qwen gains +21.4% net win-loss margin with the same recipe.
On-policy distillation trains students on their own outputs.
summary: The graphic repeats result summaries and adds a separate process diagram, while clearly identifying the benchmark, models, comparisons, and values.
